description: Prepare a wholesale purchasing request from product selection through quotation review.

hero.title: Wholesale purchasing, from product selection to quotation.
hero.copy: Browse products, prepare quantity and configuration requirements, request samples, or start a wholesale quotation.

shortlist.copy: Start with the product families you need. Product, configuration and quantity details can be prepared before requesting a quotation.

quote.copy: Wholesale quotations are prepared around the product, configuration, quantity, destination and applicable commercial requirements.

ordering.copy: From product selection to order confirmation, each step keeps product and commercial requirements connected.

steps.copy: Identify the product families or models you want to evaluate.

steps.title: Share requirements
steps.copy: Add quantities, configurations, destination and other applicable needs.

steps.title: Review quotation
steps.copy: Review the prepared product and commercial information.

steps.title: Confirm order
steps.copy: Confirm the agreed product and order information.

steps.title: Fulfillment & shipping
steps.copy: Shipping and fulfillment details are handled according to the confirmed order.
